minor.issue: Coverage type enum mismatch: Backend expects (article, mention, feature, interview, review) but Frontend uses (earned, paid, sponsored, partnership). Coverage creation from UI will fail with 422 error.

integration_issues.fix: Update COVERAGE_TYPES to use backend enum values: article, mention, feature, interview, review
